articles.title: Emily Campbell wins gold, then says MasterChef was ‘more nerve-racking’
articles.description: For more than an hour before Emily Campbell’s final lifts, a series of pretenders went through all kinds of agony trying to set a competitive target. Then up stepped Campbell, three lions weaved into her Team England-styled hair, and nonchalantly held 148kg of steel above her head. With that, the winner of the women’s heavyweight gold medal had been decided. If she were lifting a feather, it could hardly have appeared more effortless.
